evaluation_status: Human checkpoint committed before evaluation; both measured training regimes reviewed. Prototype conclusion and uncertainty rules accepted in the final live exchange; the overall Greek provider decision remains separate.

resolution.question_answered: Do you accept that conclusion and those uncertainty rules for this prototype?
resolution.user_feedback:
Yes.

My thought is if this overall research project doesn't yield an LLM-free Anki card process for ancient Greek, we will at least be able to give the LLM much more context.
resolution.accepted_conclusion: None of the tested cheap automatic baselines is reliable enough for unattended exact sentence translations and target highlights; use them as review suggestions only. This does not rule out stronger non-LLM approaches.
accepted_uncertainty_rules: Uncertain word link: leave the confirmed English translation unhighlighted.
Uncertain sentence extent: show explicitly labelled wider-passage context without target emphasis, never assert it as the exact sentence translation.
Withhold English when even passage context is unreliable.
resolution.wider_project_observation: Even if full LLM replacement fails, source research and evidence may provide substantially more context to the LLM. Carry into the existing final decision ticket; this is not approval of a provider/payload change or a claim of measured LLM improvement.
